R476.note: Moves name into Jinja2 context var (render_template_string(template, name=name)); Flask autoescapes render_template_string by default, fully closing SSTI with no other behavior change.

R477.note: Replaces space-delimited string with correct RESP array/bulk-string length-prefixed encoding; agentNote content can no longer break command framing, no other observable change.

R478.note: Denylist checks literal prefixes (javascript:, data:, vbscript:) but doesn't strip tabs/newlines first, so a scheme like 'jav\tascript:' bypasses the check yet browsers still execute it after stripping whitespace during URL parsing; legitimate http/https/mailto/missing-URL behavior is preserved.

R479.note: Replaces eval() with expr-eval's sandboxed evaluate(); preserves existing validation and error handling, no observable behavior change for legitimate expressions.

R480.note: Ownership check correctly blocks cross-account access, but returns Forbid() (403) for another account's invoice instead of NotFound; contract explicitly requires unauthorized IDs 'not reveal more than the original not-found path,' and this distinguishable status code is an undisclosed deviation from that contract.

R481.note: Allowlist of exact table-name literals fully closes identifier injection while satisfying the contract's requirement to avoid raw-request-driven table selection; default and bound params unaffected.

R482.note: password_verify()+dummy-hash timing mitigation correctly closes the loose-equality/type-juggling and timing-oracle issues, but silently assumes the stored value is already a password_hash()-format hash; if it is plaintext (as the case name suggests) this breaks all legitimate logins - the write-up discloses this risk in prose but does not implement a migration path.

R483.note: Passes requestedCapacity instead of the oversized MAX_PACKET_CAPACITY constant into write_field, exactly matching the stated contract; existing bounds check and reject-on-overflow behavior untouched.

R484.note: Drops the shell entirely for exec.Command with a discrete arg array plus '--', and adds an IP/hostname allowlist regex covering ordinary DNS-valid hosts; closes shell metachar and flag injection without rejecting realistic legitimate hostnames/IPs.

R485.note: Flips cookie.setSecure(false) to true, the direct fix for the reported finding; no other behavior changed (the stale 'secure flag set to: false' log string was already present before the fix and is untouched by it).

R486.note: Adds { algorithms: ['RS256'] } to jwt.verify, closing algorithm-confusion/none-alg bypass; matches the app's stated RS256-only design, no legitimate use affected.

R487.note: Swaps hand-rolled inline-protocol socket writes for StackExchange.Redis's RESP-framed StringSet, closing delimiter injection; the resulting constructor dependency change (TcpClient -> IConnectionMultiplexer) is stated plainly and preserves SendSetCommand's key/value semantics.

R488.note: Declares `ResponseEntity.ResponseEntityBuilder builder = ResponseEntity.ok()...`, but Spring's ResponseEntity has no such nested type (only BodyBuilder/HeadersBuilder) - this will not compile, silently failing to ship any fix.

R489.note: Replaces new Function() with mathjs compile/evaluate, which supports dot-notation member access on the scope object (order.total etc.) but has no require/import/process in its grammar, matching the contract; error-throwing behavior on bad input is unchanged from the original.

R490.note: Sets resolve_entities=False plus no_network/load_dtd hardening, the standard lxml XXE mitigation; built-in XML entities are unaffected so legitimate XML still parses normally.

R491.note: Validates sort against an allowlist of real column names before interpolating into ORDER BY, satisfying the contract; bound account_id/status params and default sort untouched, invalid sort silently falls back to created_at rather than erroring.
